meta.name: tracegen-matrix
meta.description: Requirement-to-code traceability generator — links every PRD requirement ID (User Stories, Non-Functional Requirements, Constraints) and bug code from a module's SPEC.md to the source code that implements it, and writes a per-application context/TRACEABILITY.md matrix. Resolves links primarily from the in-source CO2 traceability comments written by conductor-feature-develop and conductor-defect (e.g. `Implements: USHM00003`, `Bug fixes: [BUG-024]`), with a name-based source-scan fallback, and OPTIONAL precision enrichment from the codebase-memory knowledge graph when that MCP server is installed. Works fully WITHOUT codebase-memory. Takes an application name (mandatory), with optional version and module filters. Use when the user asks to "generate traceability", "update the traceability matrix", "link requirements to code", "regenerate TRACEABILITY.md", or when invoked as a sub-step by the feature/defect conductors after code or bug-fix changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成需求到代码的追溯矩阵
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在PRD与代码间建立可追溯的关联
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to link PRD requirements to source code

howto.what: 这个技能会扫描你的代码和需求文档，自动生成一个 TRACEABILITY.md 文件，里面列出每个需求 ID（如用户故事、非功能需求）和 Bug 编号分别对应哪些源代码文件。
howto.when: 当你要求“生成追踪矩阵”、“更新追踪矩阵”、“链接需求到代码”或“重新生成 TRACEABILITY.md”时触发。

say.text: 为应用 myapp 生成追踪矩阵。
更新 myapp 的追踪矩阵，只更新模块 user-auth。
say.note: 只刷新 user-auth 模块的追踪部分，其他模块不变。

say.text: 重新生成 myapp 的追踪矩阵，版本 v2.0.0。
say.note: 会检查版本门控，如果 v2.0.0 低于当前版本则拒绝执行。

howto.what_en: Scans your code and requirements documents to auto-generate a TRACEABILITY.md file that maps each requirement ID (e.g., user stories, non-functional requirements) and bug code to the corresponding source files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "generate traceability", "update the traceability matrix", "link requirements to code", or "regenerate TRACEABILITY.md".

say_en.text: Generate traceability matrix for app myapp.
say_en.note: Scans myapp's code and requirements, outputs TRACEABILITY.md.

say_en.text: Update traceability matrix for myapp, only module user-auth.
say_en.note: Refreshes only the user-auth module section, leaves others unchanged.

say_en.text: Regenerate traceability matrix for myapp, version v2.0.0.
say_en.note: Checks version gate; rejects if v2.0.0 is lower than current version.
